title: Beta recreation
description: This is a mod pack that re-creates the early beta and late alpha’s as closely as possible
body:
This mod pack, re-create the early beta and late alpha‘s as close as possible

make sure to select modern beta and edit the settings to make it Alpha generation

This mod is compatible with most mods, including [wonderland.jar](https://modrinth.com/mod/wonderland-jar)

There are pre-disabled mods to disable grass and the nether, if you truly want the authentic experience, including a game rule to remove sprinting
